name: PdxDataSource
description:
A non-rendering element that creates a DataSource declaratively: the reactive data layer for lists,
tables and selects.

members.name: url
members.description: REST endpoint URL. When set, creates a restTransport-backed DataSource.

members.name: data
members.description: Static data array. When set, creates an arrayTransport-backed DataSource.

members.name: transport
members.description: Custom transport object (IDataTransport). Takes priority over url/data.

members.name: idField
members.description: ID field for identifying items. Default: 'id'.

members.name: sort
members.description: Initial sort. Array of { field, dir } objects.

members.name: filter
members.description: Initial filter. Array of filter descriptors.

members.name: token
members.description:
A context token of your own, `context<DataSource<Order>>('orders')`, the source is provided
under too: a component below injects that one by it, past a nearer `<pdx-data-source>`.

members.name: source
members.description: The DataSource itself, as a computed: call it — `el.source()` — and it re-reads when the source is replaced.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: REST endpoint URL. When set, creates a restTransport-backed DataSource.

attributes.name: idfield
attributes.description: ID field for identifying items. Default: 'id'.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.
